## Open-source checklist

- [ ] I did not commit API keys, tokens, credentials, private URLs, user data, local databases, or other secrets.
- [ ] I did not add model weights, datasets, fonts, audio, images, or third-party code without checking redistribution rights.

## Migration note

The initial public source release may still contain the historical `NekoChat` name internally. Do not block functional PRs solely because the NekoChat → NekoRoom rename is not yet complete.
